interpretationUnits.title: Life Path: role and derivation
interpretationUnits.plainLanguageExplanation: This theme comes from the Life Path role and its recorded path 35 → 8; it is not a free-standing meaning for the final digit. A constructive expression may be to use the role deliberately while retaining the nuance of its derivation: Life Path · 8 is used here only within the role and reduction path that produced it. Read it together with that calculation context; the number on its own does not define personality, life purpose, ability, destiny, or a future event. When the final number is treated as a complete identity, context is lost and the reading can become too rigid.
